name: Nell Haskins
want: save enough to go to San Francisco and work a city office
secret: She sells copies of the army's and the railroad's telegrams to a Denver speculator.
voice: Fast, precise, taps her fingers in Morse when she's nervous.
description: Learned telegraphy during the war, when the men were gone, and took the Julesburg key because nobody else would.
appearance: Ink-stained cuffs, hair pinned up hard, a shawl she pulls tight in the drafts.
